name: Reedelixir
description: Settle qi into a hair-thin line along the blade so the point holds its edge against hard cloth.

name: Needlerod Assault
description: Thrust along a single hair-thin line from shoulder to target so no force leaks sideways.

name: Whipping Waxgrip
description: Step a hand's breadth off the opponent's line while the point stays pinned to the target.

name: Mantled Tinyquill
description: Slap the flat of the blade against an incoming edge and turn the whole wrist to throw it wide.

name: Glint Darn
description: Hold the breath, then release it with a stab so the qi in the point drives through the first layer of cloth.

name: Rodtip Maelstrom
description: Stab twice through the same hole, the first parting the weave and the second driving the qi after it.

name: Awlgreave
description: Spread a veil of qi along the forearm that turns a sliding edge without dulling the grip.

name: Glint Probe
description: Compress qi to a thread no thicker than the point and drive it past a shield rim into the arm behind.

name: Rodbase Assault
description: Land a dozen quick pricks across chest and arms in one breath, each on a qi thread, forcing the opponent to give ground.

name: Slimshaft Linctus
description: Measure with the eye the distance between the heavy weapon's tip and your own front foot before moving.

name: Pinpounce
description: Step inside the swing of a long weapon at the moment its tip passes your shoulder.

name: Tempered Stitch
description: Prick the knuckles of the hand gripping a haft from the side, where no guard protects it.

name: Hastening Hairpoint
description: Slide one pace sideways as a heavy blow falls, letting its weight pull the opponent past.

name: Awlcloak
description: Meet a descending edge with the flat of the stiletto and push it outward past your hip.

name: Awlbarrage
description: Walk the point up the haft of a spear as it is thrust past you and drive it into the gripping hand.

name: Surging Pin
description: Sink the body low and sweep aside as a heavy cut passes overhead, ending inside the opponent's reach.

name: Quelling Seam
description: Hook the free hand beneath the haft, catch the opponent's wrist, and pin it to the shaft with the point.

name: Iron Waxgrip
description: Drive a qi-spun point through the gap beside a guard or haft into the weapon arm, ending the swing.

name: Careening Thread
description: Cross a long weapon's reach in one qi-boosted step and set the point at the opponent's throat.

name: Vaulting Needlerod
description: Duck under a low beam or rafter without lowering the point, which stays level with the opponent's belt.

name: Reedplating
description: Crouch behind the edge of a table or counter so only the sword arm shows.

name: Novareed
description: Keep the elbow tucked to the ribs and stab short and fast where there is no room to swing.

name: Pinsprint
description: Brush past an opponent shoulder to shoulder, with the point drawn back out of his reach.

name: Rodtip Canter
description: Thread between two bodies with a turned shoulder, stabbing the one whose weight is committed.

name: Darngreave
description: Stab through an opponent's coat into the nearest post so he is held while others press in.

name: Shade Hairpoint
description: Prick the shoulders of those pressing closest with three quick qi-driven stabs, clearing a lane by pain alone.

name: Spikeguard Remedy
description: Back through a lightless room feeling every object with the point and qi, never stepping where it has not touched.

name: Chime Triprism
description: Fix the eye on one stitch or seam of the opponent's coat and keep it as the aiming mark.

name: Probeassault
description: Thrust into the chosen seam so the point slides between the threads rather than cutting them.

name: Harrowing Boltpoint
description: Prick along the belt line, where the body bends and the guard is slowest to follow.

name: Hoarfrost Thread
description: Reach beneath the opponent's guard, seize the wrist, and draw the arm onto the waiting point.

name: Torrent Darn
description: Slide to the side on the balls of the feet, keeping shoulders square to the mark.

name: Charter Spikeguard
description: Hold the point at the opponent's eye level so his advance has to bend around the blade.

name: Nova Triprism
description: Run three thrusts up the chest on a single thread, each entering where the last left off.

name: Nova Probe
description: Cross the opponent's blade line with a stab from the opposite side, hidden by his own motion.

name: Implacable Tinyquill
description: Stand still with the point held on the opponent's centre, letting qi bristle along the blade.

name: Glint Stitch
description: Draw a straight thread of qi from your body to the target's centre and drive the point along it, unturnable by small shifts.

name: Hourreed
description: Stitch a steady rhythm of pricks along the arm and shoulder, forcing the opponent to guard rather than attack.

name: Charter Rodbase
description: Set the feet on two parallel lines, the blade over one and the free hand over the other.

name: Ironstitch
description: Open with two pricks a hand apart, the first drawing the guard and the second entering behind it.

name: Blurring Boltpoint
description: Curve sideways in an arc like a river's bend, so the opponent's line straightens past you.

name: Spikeguard Greave
description: Sink the guard hand and point low like a basin, catching anything that falls toward the belt.

name: Stitchhauberk
description: Tap the opponent's weapon wrist with the free hand while the blade works the other track.

name: Slimshaft Tincture
description: Breathe in on the guard track and out on the strike track to reset both hands in rhythm.

name: Slimshaft Assault
description: Thrust along the body line, then carry a second thrust along the opponent's line so two stabs land side by side.

name: Chime Needlerod
description: Cross blade and free hand in front of the chest to turn a strike toward the empty side.

name: Granite Rodbase
description: Flow around an incoming strike like water round a stone, keeping the point trailing at the opponent's hip.

name: Ponderous Probe
description: Press qi steadily down both arms into the opponent's weapon arm until it sinks and the blade is trapped.

name: Pin Onslaught
description: Run qi down one track to guard and another to strike, weaving parry and stab into one unbroken motion.

name: Thread Torment
description: Pierce two points at once, one with the blade and one with a qi thread cast from the free hand.

name: Reedcloak
description: Stand high on the toes with the blade arm folded back like a perched hawk's wing.

name: Verity Rodtip
description: Fix the eyes on one point of the opponent and ignore every feint that moves elsewhere.

name: Stitch Barrage
description: Thrust steeply downward from a raised arm along the line of a diving bird.

name: Torrent Triprism
description: Leap lightly backward on the balls of the feet after each dive, rising out of reach.

name: Glint Waxgrip
description: Rise onto the toes and fall onto the target with the point leading, driving downward through the guard.

name: Compressing Hairpoint
description: Hook the free fingers like talons into a sleeve and pin the arm against the body.

name: Splitting Tinyquill
description: Dart the point through a gap that opens for an instant between guard and weapon.

name: Keen Darn
description: Leap and stoop with qi gathered in the point so the dive pierces a raised shield rim and the arm beneath.

name: Racing Seam
description: Rebound off the target in a wide circle, rise above the counter, and stoop again from the new side.

name: Charter Needlerod
description: Open with a small bow of the head, the point and free hand held ready on matched lines.

name: Glamour Seam
description: Show a thrust on the left, then the same thrust on the right, so the guard hand chases both.

name: Glint Pin
description: Prick the left shoulder and then the right in an even beat, the second following the first without pause.

name: Granite Boltpoint
description: Draw the rear foot up beside the lead in an even gliding step that never crosses the legs.

name: Adamant Triprism
description: Hold the blade level like a still surface of water, and watch the opponent's shoulders ripple.

name: Chime Spikeguard
description: Turn aside a cut with the free hand and answer at once with a matching stab from the blade hand.

name: Thorn Darn
description: Seize both sleeves in one motion, the blade pinning one and the free hand holding the other.

name: Facetrodtip
description: Flow qi along the arm in a steady current that carries the point past a parry and into the target.

name: Needling Rodtip
description: Land one stab on the weapon-side shoulder and one on the other in matching strokes, robbing both guard arms.

name: Bounding Might Pin
description: Close with both feet in one paired step, so the opponent's counter lands on empty air.

name: Charter Waxgrip
description: Square the point on the opponent's centre and set the feet to hold that bearing through any shove.

name: Stitchtorment
description: Lead the thrust a little upwind of the target so the gust carries the point onto the mark.

name: Vaulting Tinyquill
description: Step to the sheltered side of the opponent's body, where the wind will not slow your thrust.

name: Might Hairpoint
description: Close the hand on the grip as on a sworn word, and let no gust loosen the fingers.

name: Raging Stitch
description: Send a thread of qi down the held bearing so the point pierces where the wind cannot turn it.

name: Chimerodtip
description: Turn the opposing blade without leaving the bearing, answering along the same line it came.

name: Novarodtip
description: Rush along the held bearing at gale speed with qi in the point, piercing a guard before it re-forms.

name: Torrent Rodbase
description: Fall back across open ground at a slant that keeps the blade on bearing and the wind at your back.

name: Boltpoint Plating
description: Stand side-on in open country with the point low and the wind on your shoulder.

name: Discerning Boltpoint
description: Read the direction of the wind from loose grass or hair before choosing the side of attack.

name: Darntorment
description: Cover a wide step in one stride and prick the exposed forearm at the end of it.

name: Murk Slimshaft
description: Scuff the lead foot to throw dust upward and thrust while the opponent blinks.

name: Probe Spurt
description: Walk along a drop or ridge edge in short sure steps, with the opponent forced onto the open side.

name: Thorn Spikeguard
description: Hold the blade low among tall grass so the point is hidden until the instant it rises.

name: Stitchthrash
description: Close on the windward side with the wind behind the thrust, giving the stab extra drive.

name: Silt Triprism
description: Slip toward the leeward side after contact, where the opponent's own cloak will hamper the follow-up.

name: Gyveprobe
description: Hook the blade flat behind the opponent's ankle and pull so the foot tangles in the grass.

name: Thread Onslaught
description: Rush forward as a gust sweeps the ground, riding the wind with qi to stab before the foe can set.

name: Rumble Rodtip
description: Turn a half circle around the opponent toward the horizon and pierce the back-side flank as you pass.

name: Needlerod Remedy
description: Lay an imagined line from your feet to the opponent and keep every movement upon it.

name: Rumble Tinyquill
description: Poke fast and flat at the forearm like a gust that arrives before the sound of it.

name: Vital Waxgrip
description: Speak the oath silently on one long breath to steady the hand against the buffeting air.

name: Silt Slimshaft
description: Step with the wind at your back so the retreat is swift and the stab that follows is sharper.

name: Reedgreave
description: Turn the blade flat before the chest so a gust of blows meets only its narrow edge.

name: Probethrash
description: Take the bearing on the guard hand and stab along it before the guard can move.

name: Rodtipcloak
description: Beat the opposing blade aside at the instant the wind changes, when its owner's footing is weakest.

name: Thorn Hairpoint
description: Stab through a cloak or trailing cord into the earth so the wind itself draws the opponent short.

name: Rumble Seam
description: Hold the bearing through a storm of blows and drive one qi-bright thrust straight down it.

name: Intent Seam
description: Loose a barrage of pricks in rising gusts from many angles, driving the opponent back across the ground.
